messages.author: 84e6ff87e445f88b
messages.subject: predict() with missing data
parts:
Dear all,
I need to extract factor scores from a growth model (intercept and slope). I have missing data at some time points and predict() gives me the factor scores only for the individuals with complete data at all time. In some other thread, it was suggested to use multiple imputation and average predicted scores, however, it would be much easier if i could obtain them directly.
So I wanted to know if this feature will be available in a (near?) future.
Below is a simple made-up example (some convergence issues but is ok to illustrate the predict issue)
Thanks a lot for lavaan! that I have been using a lot lately,
JB


dataEx=data.frame(age1=rnorm(20 , mean=0 , sd=1),
                  age2=rnorm(20 , mean=2 , sd=1.2),
                  age3=rnorm(20 , mean=4 , sd=1.1))

mod <- ' i =~ 1*age1 + 1*age2 + 1*age3
s =~ 0*age1 + 1*age2 + 2*age3'

Fit <- growth(mod , data=dataEx)
summary(Fit)
predict(Fit)

dataEx1=dataEx
dataEx1[c(2,3,4),c(2)]=NA
dataEx1

Fit1 <- growth(mod , data=dataEx1,missing="FIML")
summary(Fit1)
predict(Fit1)

Dear Yves,
When I posted, I had no idea this was a controversial and quite complicated issue. From what I found, Mplus does provide factor scores with missing data. The Technical Appendix 11 on Mplus site specifies how they calculate factor scores but I am not sure it covers the missing data case and whether it would be useful for programming (far too technical for me).

I also found a recent article on factor scores and missing data by Estabrook and Neale, A Comparison of Factor Score Estimation Methods in the Presence of Missing Data: Reliability and an Application to Nicotine Dependence, Multivariate Behav Res. 2013 January 1; 48(1): 1–27.
I believe they have an appendix on how to implement that in R, package OpenMx. Maybe that would be of more direct help?

Thank you again, lavaan is very user-friendly and versatile, in addition to be open source!, I advertise it when  I can and I hope to cite your paper soon (depending on reviewers good will :)
JB
